title: Zerodha Portfolio Summary
description: Account-level funds and margins for the equity segment, synced from Zerodha via Kite Connect v3.

cash.description: Available cash balance in paise (minor units of INR).

used_margin.description: Margin utilised by open positions in paise.

total_margin.description: Total margin available (cash + collateral) in paise.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Zerodha accounts are INR-denominated.

account_type.description: Margin segment the summary was fetched from.

cash_pct.description: Computed cash as a percentage of total portfolio value, derived by the sync job.

monthly_return_pct.description: Computed month-on-month portfolio return percentage, derived by the sync job from consecutive snapshots.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Computed peak-to-trough drawdown percentage, derived by the sync job from the portfolio value history.
